title: Best of the Best
plot_overview: Two childhood friends join UCLA’s competitive Bollywood-fusion dance team, hoping to make it to the US championships. As they juggle academic pressures, team challenges, and their own ambitions, the competition tests their friendship and prompts them to reckon with the choices they make for themselves and each other.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re in the mood for a nostalgic, feel-good dance movie with friendship, humor, and Bollywood-fusion music; not for you if you want an original plot or consistently convincing dance routines.
review_summary: Pros: upbeat music; warm friendship; feel-good energy | Cons: familiar plot; uneven dance scenes; dated conflicts
